The Story

❌

The Problem

Started with automated email flow to 16 AMs. Finance team feedback: emails still too much manual work.

✅

The Solution

Evolved into full web portal: PIN auth → AM reviews online → Admin dashboard with real-time tracking → Clear HTML email reports via Resend

📊

The Proof

V1: Email flow. V2: Full-stack web app with auth, built from team feedback. Replaced manual invoice review entirely.
